records.excerpt: The official GLA ArcGIS service is the public Cultural Infrastructure Map service. It lists 37 named layers, including archives, arts centres, cinemas, community centres, libraries, museums, music venues, pubs and theatres; it supports JSON query formats and the Identify operation.

records.excerpt: The Greater London Authority Cultural Infrastructure Map plots cultural infrastructure locations alongside contextual data. The published audits are snapshots based on best available information, and the page links the public map service that supports data queries.

records.excerpt: ArcGIS documents Identify as a read-only map-service operation that discovers features at a geographic location. Each result can contain layer ID, layer name, geometry and attributes; geometry, spatial reference, tolerance, map extent and image display define the bounded search.
records.web_line_scope: official Identify operation semantics and required request parameters
